name: Kaichu type
axes: right-handed: X longitudinal/bow-positive; Y up; Z transverse
dimensionBasis: Existing recognition drawing dimensions (see its measurement caveats)

reference.configuration: Early Kaichu I family proportions and aft-of-tower deck gun, informed by the 1919 Ro-11 photograph. This is an original interpretation of the game’s mixed early Kaichu aggregate, not a claim of an exact Ro-11 fit: the catalog abstracts all six tubes as internal, while individual early boats also carried external trainable tubes. Fine casing and plan detail are reconstructed; no later Kaichu VII conning tower or foredeck gun is substituted.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
